component.scope: Use the saved first post-fork observation from the current 224-world hybrid policy. Only test right-turn worlds under the existing preceding one-second gyro gate. Feed the identical right-turn observation to official and learned ONNX actors, compare projected targets and preserve the nominal actor history.
component.comparison: An eligible old failure must have a projected target change of at least 0.02 rad and at least three times its own 95th percentile per-step maximum joint difference in the two unchanged one-second branches. Compare also the previous yaw-only proposal. This is a component admission criterion for a dynamic experiment.

dynamic_followup: If the component screen passes, freeze a bounded right-turn candidate with duplicate unchanged references from the same fork, original seven-command gates, a fresh development cohort and independent full-length verification. Establish net rescue above reference variation before releasing a candidate.
